description: This file defines the NoteStorage class responsible for local persistence of notes using shared_preferences. It provides methods to load and save notes, interacting with JSON serialization and storage mechanisms.

classes.name: NoteStorage
classes.description: Provides methods to load and save notes from local storage using shared_preferences.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously loads notes from local storage, decoding JSON data into a list of Note objects.

methods.name: saveNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously saves a list of Note objects to local storage by encoding them as JSON.
